inputs.xtext_rule_text:
fragment ControlNodePrefix returns SysML::OccurrenceUsage :
	  RefPrefix
	  ( isIndividual ?= 'individual' )?
	  ( portionKind = PortionKind )?
	  UsageExtensionKeyword*
;

notes: re-scoped from the shared unit to sysml alone (ADR-0015)
decision: SysML 8.2.2.17.3 states this production, but prints `( isIndividual ?= 'individual )?` with no closing quote, so read literally the literal never terminates and no rule can be derived. The quote is closed: the intended literal is 'individual', which the attribute name isIndividual, the `?=` idiom and the pilot grammar all agree on, and which is the minimal repair. Recorded as the deviation ControlNodePrefix, follow_spec; the defect is filed as SYSML21-400, open. Otherwise the clause is transcribed: `isIndividual ?=` and the `{ isPortion = true }` beside PortionKind are assignments into the abstract syntax and contribute no tokens, so the rule carries the keyword and the kind alone.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription with the unterminated literal closed.
Why the literal reads 'individual' rather than running to the end of the clause.
Open. 'ControlNodePrefix missing closing quote after 'individual'. Page fetched and body read on 2026-09-17.
Line 12 `join J;` and line 34 `merge M;` each take this prefix in its wholly empty form, every part being optional or a star.
Second opinion. Identical once the quote is closed; it writes `( isIndividual ?= 'individual' )?`.
